title: Gauss Lab: Charge and Flux
summary: Weigh charged objects, count the flux through closed surfaces and use symmetry to find the flux through one face.
subject: physics
concepts: Linear, surface and volume charge density
Zero net flux does not mean no charge
Flux through part of a surface by symmetry
learningOutcome: The student can find total charge from a density, the net flux from the enclosed charge, the charge from a flux, and the flux through one face of a cube using symmetry.

levels.title: Charge from density
levels.adds: Baseline: choose λ, σ or ρ for the shape and find the total charge (Ex 1.21a).
hints: A line carries charge per length (λ), a surface carries charge per area (σ), a volume carries charge per volume (ρ).
Total charge = density × length, area or volume.
A sphere has area 4πr² and volume (4/3)πr³.

levels.title: Flux through a closed surface
levels.adds: New idea: net flux = enclosed charge / ε₀, whatever the surface, and charges outside do not count (Ex 1.18, 1.19).
hints: Add up only the charges inside the surface, with their signs.
Φ = q / ε₀ with ε₀ = 8.854 × 10⁻¹² C²/(N m²). Convert µC to C.
Resizing the surface changes the answer only if it passes over a charge.

levels.title: The black box
levels.adds: New idea: find the charge from a measured flux, and see that zero net flux does not mean no charge (Ex 1.16).
hints: q = ε₀ Φ. A flux that points inwards means a negative charge.
Zero net flux means the net charge is zero, not that there is none.
Equal and opposite charges inside give zero net flux.

levels.title: A face of the cube
levels.adds: New idea: use symmetry to share the flux between the faces of a cube (Ex 1.17).
hints: First find the flux through the whole cube, or the share of it, from Gauss’s law.
A charge at the centre sends equal flux through all six faces.
A charge at a corner is shared by eight cubes. Faces that touch the corner have zero flux; the other three share the rest.

misconceptions: Charges outside a closed surface add to its net flux
The flux depends on the size or shape of the surface
Zero net flux means there is no charge inside
A cube around a charge at a corner has the same flux as one around a charge at its centre
